items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 2.6% in 1985 to 4.3% in 2025 across 130 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

2 of 130 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 5 of 6 high-need ones have none.
